purpose: Internal inventory of public claims and recommended dispositions. The freeze records the inventory. It does not rewrite public copy, publish, announce, or authorize Tracks 16 through 21.
t14_disposition_note: Recommended dispositions live on this ledger. PUBLIC-SURFACE-INVENTORY.json disposition fields stay UNREVIEWED. This freeze does not authorize a public rewrite, so it does not write those fields.

freeze.tip_sha_note: A commit cannot store its own SHA. content_commit_sha is null until the seal commit records the commit that introduced these claim rows. The seal commit does not change claim rows or authorization flags. FROZEN_INVENTORY is not the tip SHA of a publish.

disposition_meanings.KEEP: Leave the public sentence. Not permission to republish it.
disposition_meanings.REWRITE: A later public-copy change is recommended. Not performed.
disposition_meanings.HOLD: Do not change the surface. Used when evidence is thin or the change would reopen a frozen version, yank a release, or add a file.
disposition_meanings.RETIRE: A later removal is the content recommendation. This ledger does not use RETIRE as an executing disposition. Where removal would yank or unpublish, the executing disposition is HOLD and RETIRE is later_action_not_authorized.
disposition_meanings.EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ACTION_REQUIRED: The surface is outside this repository or is an account setting. Not permission to log in.
disposition_meanings.DEFER_TO_T16: Canonical public language is Track 16. This force does not write that language.

evidence_method.rule: Evidence is the T14 register plus files on inventory source 03995835c88a4ebcca2ee3b8c1ae7fa490d21653. Missing proof stays UNKNOWN or UNSUPPORTED. CONFLICTING means the public surfaces or the in-repo files disagree. SUPPORTED is not a runtime pass.
not_evidence: A roadmap item treated as shipped
Optics observation treated as Phantom Engine enforcement
An HTTP 404 treated as proof a repository does not exist

closed_actions: Rewrite website, README, release-note, npm, or PyPI copy.
Execute Track 16 canonical language, Track 17 rewrite staging, or Tracks 18 through 21.
Edit LinkedIn, X, the Vercel project, or the GitHub org description.
Issue credentials, move money, or deploy to a customer.

out_of_scope_tracks.16: Canonical public language. Not written here.
out_of_scope_tracks.17: Public rewrite staging. Not staged here.
out_of_scope_tracks.18_through_21: Not executed. This force does not assign their titles.
